Venue: KuCoin
Headline: What's more? You can continue earning a est. 4% KCUSD APR rewards every day!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
KCUSD is now available as a margin asset in KuCoin Unified Trading Account (UTA). This feature is available to all KuCoin VIP users at VIP 1 and above. Eligible users can transfer KCUSD from their Funding Account to UTA and use it as margin in supported trading scenarios.
Eligible KCUSD units held in UTA continue earning up to 4% APR under the applicable product rules. Rewards are credited daily to the Funding Account in KCUSD units and automatically added to the subsequent reward calculation balance.
This upgrade connects earning and trading without requiring users to redeem KCUSD or convert it into another margin asset first.
## Key Benefits
Trade While Earning 4% APR
Eligible KCUSD units held in UTA continue earning.
Daily Rewards With Automatic Compounding
Rewards are credited daily to the Funding Account and automatically added to the subsequent reward calculation balance.
Transfer KCUSD Directly to UTA
Move KCUSD between the Funding Account and UTA without redeeming or converting it into another margin asset first.
## How to Use
Subscribe to KCUSD through KuCoin Earn at a 1:1 ratio using USDT, USDC, or USDG with no subscription fee.
Select Transfer on the Assets page and move KCUSD from the Funding Account to UTA.
Use KCUSD as margin in supported UTA trading scenarios.
View your margin assets in UTA and daily rewards on the KCUSD asset page.
## How to Redeem
Make sure the KCUSD to be redeemed is not required to meet current margin requirements.
Transfer KCUSD from UTA back to the Funding Account.
Open the KCUSD product page and submit a redemption request.
Redemptions are generally settled in the original subscription asset, subject to the product page and terms; this is not guaranteed.
## Important Notes
The 4% APR is not fixed or guaranteed. The actual APR displayed on the KCUSD product page prevails.
Eligible KCUSD units start accruing rewards on T+1 after subscription, with the first reward generally credited on T+2.
Rewards generated by KCUSD held in UTA are credited to the Funding Account.
Some or all KCUSD may be unavailable for transfer while required to meet margin requirements.
If losses, liabilities, or liquidation occur, KCUSD may be disposed of under the applicable UTA risk-control and liquidation rules.
This feature is currently available to users at VIP 1 and above. Availability remains subject to the user’s jurisdiction and account status.
Risk Notice
KuCoin does not promise fixed rewards or guaranteed returns. The autual APR displayed on the KCUSD product page prevails. The margin value, uasge limits, supported scenarios, and transfer conditions of KCUSD as trading margin are subject to the UTA page and applicable rules. Using KCUSD as margin involves trading, leverage, and liquidation risks, and may result in asset losses. The feature will be rolled out in phases to eligible users. Users should fully understand the product rules before making any decision, proceed prudently, and bear all the risks. KuCoin is not responsible for any investment loss.

Venue: KuCoin
Headline: We’re celebrating the launch of KuCoin 5.0 with an exclusive 100 USDT community challenge!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
- Users must join the campaign via the official announcement link from social media channel (eg: Telegram, X, Reddit, Discord) to be eligible for participation.
- Eligibility: This activity is exclusive to brand-new registered users.
- Giveaway Terms: Rewards from the Lucky Draw include Futures Position Airdrop. If the position incurs a loss, you will owe nothing. Users can withdraw a maximum profit of $2 USDT (5% of the position value) upon closing the position.
- Transaction volume does not count towards zero-fee transactions.
- Platform Rights: KuCoin reserves the right to disqualify users who are found to be engaging in malicious behaviors, including but not limited to wash trading, mass account registrations, or unusual trading patterns. KuCoin reserves the right to the final interpretation of this campaign.
- Apple Inc. is not a sponsor and is not affiliated with this event.
